notes: Adds "Export as Obbligato file" to a piece's ⋯ menu. It saves one piece - the PDF, your annotations, bookmarks and any hymn index you have built on it - as a single file you can carry across to the Windows version on a memory stick or through Dropbox. Until now the only way to move a piece to Windows was to back up your entire library, which for a full library is hundreds of megabytes just to move one book. Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
